annotations.title: JSON schema from example: infer a JSON Schema

description: Infer a JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) from an example JSON value: types, nested object properties, required keys, array item shapes merged across all items, and string formats (date-time, date, email, uri, uuid). Use to document an API response or to validate later data against the same shape. Example: json={"id":1,"email":"ada@example.com","tags":["a","b"],"created":"2026-10-23T08:00:00Z"}.
